free_tier_limits.correction: Completely free with no rate limits on the REST API since static hosting (Nov 2018); fair-use policy requires local caching; IP bans for abuse (not a soft rate limit)

rate_limits.correction: Rate limiting removed entirely for REST API since Nov 2018; fair-use policy (cache locally; IP ban for abuse). GraphQL at graphql.pokeapi.co has 100 calls/h per IP.

notes: REST rate limiting is not soft/unpublished—docs state it was removed entirely in Nov 2018 after static hosting. Fair-use is cache + no DoS (permanent IP ban), not rate limiting. GraphQL alone is rate-limited (100/h/IP).
